## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do and why? -->

## Type of change

<!-- Conventional Commits type; this becomes the release-please changelog entry -->

- [ ] `feat` — new feature (minor bump)
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix (patch bump)
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` / `style` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` — build system or CI
- [ ] `chore` — maintenance
- [ ] **Breaking change** (add `!` after the type or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer → major bump)

## Checklist

- [ ] `task ci` passes locally (build, vet, lint, test)
- [ ] `task pre-commit` passes locally
- [ ] Commit messages / PR title follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (enforced by CI)
